_note: The decision-338 lever-column arm table (data-driven; owner rulings 338, 341 A of 2026-10-19: false-fill suppression L1 and Perception candidate union L2 on the Thinking core, TRAIN Fold B). Each candidate arm carries exactly ONE sampling axis of the level-2 Perception-branch group (roles.perception.sampling_variants, receipt saea-perception-branch-arms-v6): l1-support fans out solver_samples (n same-prompt Solver contacts, sample 0 greedy at the lock seed, samples 1..n-1 at the arm's decoding with seed = lock seed + offset, committed by saea-commit-first-support-v1) and l2-union fans out perception_samples (k Perception contacts merged into the Solver's shortlist by saea-perception-candidate-union-v1, capped at the Solver's own max_candidates). Every arm renders the lock's templates, evidence and QueryState; the per-node thinking budget (3,072 / cap 4,096), the response format and the tool authority are the lock's. The twin aa (replicate_of lock) and the delivering arm lock (the lock's request, no axis) are added by the compiler, aa then lock LAST.
